_comment: Local engineering ratchets on shipped skill roots (issues #5762, PR #7871). max_total_chars caps aggregate description characters, set just above the measured corpus; it is a local ratchet, not a measured limit of any model host. max_listing_chars caps ListingChars (the sum of 93 + len(name) + len(description) per skill, where 93 is the Copilot CLI per-entry markup cost for project entries); it is set at exactly the measured value and tied to that measured host entry cost. No Claude Code entry cost or budget is measured, so none is listed. Ratchet rule: lower a value in the same PR as each cut; raise one only with a reviewed reason. host_budgets records each published or observed host listing budget with its state and source; they feed the fit report and do not gate. Enforced by .github/workflows/skill-passive-compliance.yml.

host_budgets.source: PR #7871 evidence note receipt B: largest observed full-entry total 14,915 across 9,390 local sessions, Copilot CLI 1.0.32 to 1.0.116
PR #7871 evidence note upstream source 2 (source 1 says 15,000)
